propositions: git stash operations in the tickets worktree can pop stash entries created in other worktrees because the stash stack is shared across all linked worktrees of a repository
a stash created on one source branch was popped into the tickets worktree, leaving unmerged index entries and corrupting the store with non-ticket source files
the stash->merge->pop dance in push.py:167-200 assumes all stashed modifications are reconciler-regenerable, but foreign stashes from other branches violate this assumption
auto-heal in event_append._recover_from_unmerged must classify foreign paths not tracked on the tickets branch so they are discarded rather than wedging every store write
a supported tracker-maintenance entrypoint with pre-write backup, refusal on unpushed commits, and durable audit logging must replace ad-hoc raw git operations
the maintained tracker must not use git stash (shared, repo-global) for worktree-local intent; sha-addressed commits via stash create/apply provide worktree isolation
